sentences.zh: 我们如何与儿童谈论死亡？

sentences.zh: 当死亡是由自杀引起时，我们如何与儿童谈论死亡？

sentences.en: These are really difficult questions in parenting, but also in mental health.
sentences.zh: 这些不仅是育儿中的难题，也是心理健康领域的难题。

sentences.en: How do we get the tone right?
sentences.zh: 我们如何把握好说话的语气？

sentences.en: What questions are okay to answer?
sentences.zh: 哪些问题是可以回答的？

sentences.en: What questions are okay to ask?
sentences.zh: 哪些问题是可以提问的？

sentences.en: How do we phrase things?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何措辞？

sentences.en: I am chatting through all of this and more with Caroline Roothouse in today's episode.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我将与卡罗琳·鲁特豪斯一起探讨所有这些以及更多内容。

sentences.en: I hope you find this so useful.
sentences.zh: 我希望你会觉得这非常有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Today's episode is part of our special season, talking about suicide and trying to normalise conversations surrounding it.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目是我们特别季的一部分，主题是谈论自杀并努力让围绕它的对话正常化。

sentences.en: This is episode two in our special series of three.
sentences.zh: 这是我们三集特别系列的第二集。

sentences.en: They are all separate episodes, but you might well find it helpful to catch the other two if you do have time.
sentences.zh: 它们都是独立的节目，但如果你有时间，听听另外两集可能会对你很有帮助。

sentences.en: So I know you're here because you have questions about how to do this and what is appropriate.
sentences.zh: 我知道你来到这里是因为你对如何做到这一点以及什么才是合适的存有疑问。

sentences.en: So let's dive straight into the episode and I will catch you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 让我们直接切入正题，我们在节目另一端见。

sentences.en: Hi, I just want to welcome along our guest for today, Caroline Roothouse.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我只想欢迎我们今天的嘉宾卡罗琳·鲁特豪斯。

sentences.en: Hi, Caroline.
sentences.zh: 嗨，卡罗琳。

sentences.en: Hi, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 嗨，玛丽安。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time in speaking with us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽空与我们交谈。

sentences.en: Just want to firstly say that I was so sorry to learn of the death of your husband and the father of your children.
sentences.zh: 首先，我只想说，得知你丈夫以及你孩子的父亲去世的消息，我感到非常难过。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: I appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Did you want to tell us a little bit about him?
sentences.zh: 你想跟我们多聊聊他吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: So I met Steve in the year 2000.
sentences.zh: 我和史蒂夫是在2000年认识的。

sentences.en: We were set up on a blind date, which I wasn't happy about, but then clearly was in the end.
sentences.zh: 我们是通过相亲认识的，当时我对此很不高兴，但最后显然觉得挺好。

sentences.en: And we hit it off straight away.
sentences.zh: 我们一拍即合。

sentences.en: Steve was quite a chilled out character, which helped balance me out because I'm quite highly strung.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫是一个性格相当随和的人，这有助于平衡我，因为我这个人神经比较紧绷。

sentences.en: So we kind of met in the middle very well.
sentences.zh: 所以我们俩在中间找到了很好的平衡点。

sentences.en: But he was full of energy and kindness and warmth.
sentences.zh: 但他充满了活力、善良和温暖。

sentences.en: And he had friends all over the world, which was very appealing.
sentences.zh: 他在世界各地都有朋友，这一点非常有吸引力。

sentences.en: He was very drawn to speed sports, motorbikes, those sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 他非常喜欢极限速度运动、摩托车以及诸如此类的东西。

sentences.en: And he introduced me to lots of those sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 他把我引入了许多这样的世界。

sentences.en: And he had a love for travel, as did I.
sentences.zh: 他和我都热爱旅行。

sentences.en: So we had a huge amount in common.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有非常多的共同点。

sentences.en: And, yeah, as I say, we hit it off very, very quickly.
sentences.zh: 而且，正如我所说，我们非常非常快地就合拍了。

sentences.en: And we spent a good few years together before we got married in 2005 and then started our kind of family life together beyond that.
sentences.zh: 我们在一起度过了美好的几年，然后在2005年结婚，并在此之后开始了我们的家庭生活。

sentences.en: And so in work, Steve worked for a field marketing agency.
sentences.zh: 在工作中，史蒂夫在一家实地营销公司工作。

sentences.en: And his role was to look after teams of people who would go and train others on mobile phones and how to use and sell them in retail stores.
sentences.zh: 他的职责是管理团队，这些团队会去指导其他人了解手机，以及如何在零售店里使用和销售它们。

sentences.en: And I think it helps to understand how he was perceived in that industry to understand the sort of person that he was,
sentences.zh: 我认为，要理解他是怎样一个人，就要了解他在那个行业里是如何被看待的，

sentences.en: because he was very well known for being an amazing motivational leader and helping a lot of younger people to kind of get onto the career ladder, giving all of his time,
sentences.zh: 因为他以成为一名出色的励志领导者而闻名，他帮助许多年轻人踏上职业生涯，奉献了自己所有的宝贵时间，

sentences.en: coaching them, supporting them, encouraging them and being very motivational and inspiring.
sentences.zh: 指导他们、支持他们、鼓励他们，并且非常有动力和启发性。

sentences.en: So very much a positive person, which, again, I was drawn to on a personal level.
sentences.zh: 所以他绝对是一个积极向上的人，这也是我个人所被吸引的地方。

sentences.en: And I guess in later years, as we talk about things like spotting signs when somebody's struggling, once we'd started to have children,
sentences.zh: 我想在后来的几年里，当我们谈论诸如发现某人在挣扎时的迹象时，自从我们有了孩子以后，

sentences.en: I could see that energy reducing and that love for life and for work and for people generally, which I put down to just being a knackered parent, really.
sentences.zh: 我能看到那种活力在减少，对生活、工作和一般人的那种热爱也在消退，我当时真的把这归咎于精疲力竭的父母身份。

sentences.en: And all the things that go with lack of sleep and parenting and getting older and those sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 以及所有与睡眠不足、育儿、变老等相关的事情。

sentences.en: So with hindsight, I can look back and maybe think differently about that now.
sentences.zh: 所以事后看来，我如前回顾，现在可能会对那段时光有不同的看法。

sentences.en: But yeah, that was Steve.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，这就是史蒂夫。

sentences.en: Happy guy for most of the time that I knew him and that we were together.
sentences.zh: 在我认识他以及我们在一起的大部分时间里，他都是个快乐的人。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: And before we started recording, you told me that this had really come out of the blue.
sentences.zh: 在我们开始录音之前，你告诉我这件事完全是突如其来的。

sentences.en: This wasn't a case of of someone with an existing diagnosed depression or that had kind of evidence that life didn't seem to be worth living.
sentences.zh: 这不是那种有现存确诊抑郁症或有证据表明生活似乎不值得活下去的情况。

sentences.en: This was someone who was hustling out the door in the morning telling you that they'd be picking up your child from cubs like usual and they'd see you then.
sentences.zh: 这是一个早上急冲冲出门的人，告诉你他会像往常一样去接你的孩子参加幼童军，然后就会见到你。

sentences.en: And that's not what happened.
sentences.zh: 但事情并非如此。

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不是。

sentences.en: No, I had no idea that Steve was struggling at all.
sentences.zh: 不，我完全不知道史蒂夫在挣扎。

sentences.en: As I said, that the energy had reduced in him, but there was there was no suggestion that he had any mental health difficulties or was considering suicide in any way.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，他体内的活力有所减少，但没有任何迹象表明他有任何心理健康困难，也没有任何迹象表明他有任何自杀的倾向。

sentences.en: So it was the 12th of November, 2018.
He was starting a new role with a new client through this field marketing agency on that day.
sentences.zh: 那天他正在通过这家实地营销公司与一个新客户开始新的工作。

sentences.en: We were running around getting ready for for work and I was getting our two young children ready for school and nursery.
sentences.zh: 我们当时正忙着准备上班，我正在帮我们两个小孩子准备去学校和幼儿园。

sentences.en: Ada and Evie were nine and two at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时艾达和埃维分别九岁和两岁。

sentences.en: And Steve was getting ready for work.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫正在准备上班。

sentences.en: Even just before he left for the for the day, I had a sore throat, which I mentioned to him.
sentences.zh: 甚至在他出门之前，我提到我喉咙痛。

sentences.en: And he went flying up the stairs two at a time to grab me some throat sweets from the bathroom cabinet so that, you know,
sentences.zh: 他三步并作两步地飞奔上楼，从浴室柜里给我拿润喉糖，你知道的，

sentences.en: just the way he would always be thinking of others and helping.
sentences.zh: 这就是他那种总是想着别人、乐于助人的方式。

sentences.en: And then off he went, just confirming that he'd pick Evie up from cubs on his way home, as he always did on a on a Monday evening.
sentences.zh: 然后他就出发了，临走前确认他会在周一傍晚回家的路上像往常一样顺便接埃维参加幼童军。

sentences.en: And I didn't I didn't give anything a second thought.
sentences.zh: 我当时没有多想。

sentences.en: I had no need to until I had a phone call from his work saying that he hadn't arrived.
sentences.zh: 我根本不需要多想，直到我接到他公司打来的电话，说他没有到达目的地。

sentences.en: It was about an hour away.
sentences.zh: 车程大约是一个小时。

sentences.en: So the assumption was that he'd his car had broken down, maybe, and he was somewhere by the side of the road with no signal.
sentences.zh: 所以大家以为他的车可能抛锚了，正身处路边某个没有信号的地方。

sentences.en: And that's why he hadn't notified anybody.
sentences.zh: 这就是他为什么没有通知任何人的原因。

sentences.en: But as the day went on and there was no sign of him in the end, I had to contact the police and register him as a missing person.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间推移，他依然踪迹全无，最后我不得不联系警察并将他登记为失踪人口。

sentences.en: And that's when I went into full panic mode.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我进入了完全恐慌的状态。

sentences.en: And that's when the the nightmare really began.
sentences.zh: 也是在那时，真正的噩梦开始了。

sentences.en: And the police were kind of not treating it as serious in any way because he had no history of mental health difficulties or no reason to be missing that would suggest he would be coming to any harm.
sentences.zh: 警方起初并没有太把这当回事，因为他没有心理健康问题史，也没有任何失踪的理由表明他会受到任何伤害。

sentences.en: But they they came on the Wednesday morning, two days later.
sentences.zh: 但他们在周三早上、也就是两天后来到了。

sentences.en: And that's when I heard those those 15 words that I'll never forget.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，我听到了那15个我永远不会忘记的字。

sentences.en: And they said to me, we found him.
sentences.zh: 他们对我说，我们找到他了。

sentences.en: He's not alive.
sentences.zh: 他已经不在了。

sentences.en: And it's clear that he's done it to himself.
sentences.zh: 很显然，这是他自己做出的选择。

sentences.en: And that's when everything just kind of fell apart and nothing really made sense ever again after that for me.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，一切都崩溃了，从那以后，对我来说，一切都失去了意义。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And even, you know, the phrasing of that doesn't sound hugely compassionate in terms of thinking about Steve as a person and a human and you as the wife and mother of his children.
sentences.zh: 甚至，你知道的，那种措辞在考虑到史蒂夫作为一个个体、一个人，而你作为他的妻子和孩子的母亲时，听起来并不是那么富有同情心。

sentences.en: You know, that's yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 你知道，是的，完全是这样。

sentences.en: I had my daughter with me at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时我和我女儿在一起。

sentences.en: She was two.
sentences.zh: 她两岁。

sentences.en: I had friends around me because we've been trying to work out how on earth we were going to try and find him.
sentences.zh: 我身边有朋友，因为我们一直在想方设法要怎么找到他。

sentences.en: My mum was there.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈也在那里。

sentences.en: So she broke down and struggled to take on board that news as well.
sentences.zh: 所以她也崩溃了，难以接受这个消息。

sentences.en: There wasn't a huge amount of compassion in many of the interactions that I had, including things like the inquest, for example, where they read out.
sentences.zh: 在我经历的许多互动中，并没有太多的同情，比如死因研讯之类的场合，他们在那里宣读了报告。

sentences.en: There was a huge amount of detail about the state of Steve's body when he was found in the back of his car, which I had no idea was coming.
sentences.zh: 里面有大量关于史蒂夫在汽车后备箱被发现时遗体状态的细节，我对此毫无心理准备。

sentences.en: I was given no warning.
sentences.zh: 没有人给我任何警告。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of parts of this story and different parts of the processes that come after a suicide,
sentences.zh: 这个故事中有许多部分，以及自杀后发生的各种流程的不同环节，

sentences.en: notifying utilities and the kind of cold computer says no responses that you get from people despite the circumstances.
sentences.zh: 比如通知公用事业公司，无论情况如何，你得到的都是那种冷冰冰的“计算机显示拒绝”的回应。

sentences.en: So, yeah, there have been a huge amount of moments that have have been difficult and could have been made easier.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，有很多时刻是艰难的，本来可以变得更容易一些。

sentences.en: But equally, I've experienced unbelievable compassion from people and from communities and groups of people that I wouldn't necessarily have expected to receive that from.
sentences.zh: 但同样地，我也从人们、社区以及我不一定会期望得到这种支持的人群中体验到了难以置信的同情。

sentences.en: And that's that's where my focus has had to be in the long run.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，这正是我必须将注意力集中的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm just so sorry that that's how you receive the news, probably at your front door, like no real warning or preparation.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我真的很遗憾你是在前门听到这个消息的，没有任何真正的警告或心理准备。

sentences.en: That's that's a lot.
sentences.zh: 这真的是太沉重了。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's a lot for you as a grown woman.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对你这样一个成年女性来说，这压力太大了。

sentences.en: You know, I'm a mother to two children myself.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我自己也是两个孩子的母亲。

sentences.en: And I know just how different developmentally a two year old and nine year old are, but how much they need their parents in so many different ways.
sentences.zh: 我知道两岁和九岁的孩子在发育阶段有多大不同，但他们以如此之多的不同方式需要父母。

sentences.en: How did you begin to be able to have those conversations?
sentences.zh: 你是如何开始能够进行那些对话的？

sentences.en: Probably is a separate question because of the different developmental ages.
sentences.zh: 由于他们的发育年龄不同，这或许是一个独立的问题。

sentences.en: How did you begin to have that conversation with with the eldest or the youngest?
sentences.zh: 你是如何开始与老大或老小进行这种谈话的？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's a there's a huge difference between the two.
sentences.zh: 是的，两者之间有巨大的差异。

sentences.en: And there still is because they're now 15 and eight.
sentences.zh: 现在依然如此，因为他们现在15岁和8岁了。

sentences.en: And those gaps still exist massively.
sentences.zh: 这种差距依然巨大。

sentences.en: So it's two different journeys.
sentences.zh: 所以这是两段不同的旅程。

sentences.en: I'm constantly trying to manage for them in those moments directly after I was told by police that Steve had died.
sentences.zh: 在警察告诉我史蒂夫去世后的那段直接时间里，我一直在努力为她们应付这一切。

sentences.en: Ada, who was, as I say, only two, I vividly recall seeing her sat at her little white wooden table with her colouring, with a police officer sat with her colouring, too.
sentences.zh: 艾达当时正如我所说只有两岁，我清晰地记得看到她坐在她那张白色的小木桌旁画画，一名警官也坐在她旁边陪她画画。

sentences.en: And she she seemed kind of self-contained.
sentences.zh: 她看起来很平静。

sentences.en: I don't even know if she was aware that there was anything going on.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道她是否意识到发生了什么事。

sentences.en: And I didn't have to worry too much about her in that moment.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我不需要过分担心她。

sentences.en: It was Evie, my nine year old, that I was desperately concerned about.
sentences.zh: 我拼命担心的是我九岁的埃维。

sentences.en: And things were happening around me that I just wasn't in control of.
sentences.zh: 我身边发生的很多事情是我无法控制的。

sentences.en: Somebody from safeguarding from her school turned up.
sentences.zh: 她学校的一位安全防护人员出现了。

sentences.en: She was at school at the time.
sentences.zh: 她当时正在学校。

sentences.en: And my best friend, Emma, contacted the charity Winston's Wish, which was a suggestion from the safeguarding person from school.
sentences.zh: 我的好朋友埃玛联系了温斯顿愿望慈善机构，这是学校安全防护人员的建议。

sentences.en: And they gave her a bit of a script for me to be able to talk to Evie.
sentences.zh: 他们给我提供了一点脚本，让我能够跟埃维谈话。

sentences.en: I had no idea how you deliver news like this, let alone a death, but a death by suicide.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该如何传达这样的消息，更不用说死亡了，而且还是自杀身亡。

sentences.en: She knew that Steve was was missing because I'd had to explain it to her after a couple of days, but had no idea what anything like this would be happening.
sentences.zh: 她知道史蒂夫失踪了，因为过了几天我不得不向她解释，但她根本不知道会发生这种事。

sentences.en: So armed with this kind of script and a few leaflets and pamphlets from this safeguarding person.
sentences.zh: 因此，带着这位安全防护人员提供的脚本以及一些传单和小册子，

sentences.en: I arrived at Evie's school and she had a she was standing out the front with the deputy head and she had a big smile on her face when she saw me coming because she that innocence of a child seeing their parent turn up at school.
sentences.zh: 我来到了埃维的学校，她和副校长一起站在前门外面，当她看到我来时脸上带着灿烂的笑容，因为那是孩子看到父母出现在学校时的天真。

sentences.en: But as we went into the room and she could see my my tear stained face, she knew that it was not going to be good news.
sentences.zh: 但当我们走进房间，她看到我挂着泪痕的脸时，她就知道不会是什么好消息了。

sentences.en: And from that moment, I was very clear that I had to be direct and honeSt.
sentences.zh: 从那一刻起，我非常清楚我必须直接和诚实。

sentences.en: And that's the the main advice that Winston's Wish had given me.
sentences.zh: 这也是温斯顿愿望组织给我的主要建议。

sentences.en: And I had to say so it was something along the lines of Daddy's been found and he's died and we won't be seeing him again.
sentences.zh: 我不得不这样说：爸爸被找到了，他已经去世了，我们不会再见到他了。

sentences.en: His brain had stopped working properly.
sentences.zh: 他的大脑停止正常工作了。

sentences.en: And this was the beginning of that journey for me, with Evie in particular, of kind of drip feeding that information over a period of time.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这段旅程尤其是对埃维来说，就是从那开始的，在一段时间内一点点地透露这些信息。

sentences.en: Now, for Evie, that took probably only a few months from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 现在，对于埃维来说，从头到尾可能只花了几个月的时间。

sentences.en: I'd say that there's kind of these different stages, which I can talk about in a moment.
sentences.zh: 我想说存在着不同的阶段，我一会儿可以讲讲。

sentences.en: And for Ada being two, that journey has taken years and just been drawn out across that period of time.
sentences.zh: 而对于两岁的艾达来说，这段旅程花费了数年时间，并在那段时期内不断拉长。

sentences.en: So that that first step of saying that Steve had died and he wouldn't be coming back was what I had to explain.
sentences.zh: 所以，说出史蒂夫已经去世而且不会回来的第一步，就是我必须解释的内容。

sentences.en: And then it's kind of talking in terms that they would understand that it was something that that Daddy had done to himself.
sentences.zh: 然后，她会用他们能听懂的方式去谈论这件事，让他们明白这是爸爸对自己做的事。

sentences.en: Evie had a very good understanding of mental health, thanks to conversations at school and learning that they do in PSHE sessions and those sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 多亏了学校里的交流、他们在个人、社会、健康与经济（PSHE）课程中学习的知识以及诸如此类的事情，埃维对心理健康有着很好的理解。

sentences.en: And the next thing I had to do was talk about kind of why he may have done that.
sentences.zh: 接下来我要做的事情，就是谈谈他当时为什么要这么做。

sentences.en: And we talked about mental health issues and people being unhappy and not knowing how to deal with that unhappiness or how to talk to other people about it.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论了心理健康问题，谈到了人们如何感到不快乐，却又不知道该如何应对这种不快乐，或者不知道该如何跟别人倾诉。

sentences.en: But it was very early on that Evie asked me how he'd done it, which was the hardest conversation I've ever had to have with her, harder than telling her that he'd died,
sentences.zh: 但没过多久，埃维就问我他是怎么做到的。这是我有生以来跟她进行过的最艰难的对话，甚至比告诉她他已经去世了还要艰难，

sentences.en: because it felt like such a brutal thing to have to explain.
sentences.zh: 因为必须向她解释这些，感觉是一件极其残忍的事。

sentences.en: Steve had suffocated himself with a plastic bag in his car.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫在自己的车里用一个塑料袋把自己给闷窒息了。

sentences.en: And to have to say that to a nine-year-old was horrific.
sentences.zh: 要把这些话对一个九岁的孩子说出口，实在是太可怕了。

sentences.en: But again, the advice from Winston's Wish was, when they ask, they're ready to know.
sentences.zh: 但温斯顿的心愿组织（Winston's Wish）给出的建议依然是：当他们主动发问时，他们就已经准备好了解真相了。

sentences.en: And it's our responsibility as parents to deliver that news in the most considered and compassionate way and using language that they would understand.
sentences.zh: 而作为父母，我们的责任是以最周到、最充满同情心的方式，并使用他们能够理解的语言，把这个消息传递给他们。

sentences.en: And that's what I was intent on doing whenever I needed to.
sentences.zh: 每当需要的时候，我都是下定决心要这么做的。

sentences.en: So that whole kind of process with Evie, as I say, was done over the course of a few months.
sentences.zh: 所以，正如我所说，和埃维经历的整个过程，是在几个月的时间里一点点完成的。

sentences.en: I'm still working on that process with Ada.
sentences.zh: 我现在还在和艾达一起经历这个过程。

sentences.en: We haven't got to the point yet where I've explained to her what he actually did, because she hasn't shown any need to know that information yet.
sentences.zh: 我们还没到那一步，我还没向她解释他实际上做了什么，因为她目前还没有表现出了解这些信息的需求。

sentences.en: But what she does know is her own understanding of mental health difficulties and how they can be so great that somebody can choose to take their own life or see that as the only option,
sentences.zh: 但她确实了解的内容，是她自己对心理健康困境的理解，知道这些困境可能会沉重到让一个人选择结束自己的生命，或者认为这是唯一的出路，

sentences.en: at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 至少对她来说是这样的。

sentences.en: She has said to me, there was one moment where I was walking her to school one morning and she came out with this really profound statement.
sentences.zh: 她曾对我说过——有天早上我送她去上学时，她突然说出了一番非常深奥的话。

sentences.en: And she said it was something along the lines of men don't cry and they don't grieve and they really should.
sentences.zh: 她说的话大致意思是：男人不哭，他们也不悲伤，而他们其实应该哭的。

sentences.en: Because if they don't, and they don't let the emotions out, they can die.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他们不这样做，不把情绪释放出来，他们可能会死掉。

sentences.en: And whilst it was a shocking thing to hear on the way to school when it wasn't the normal conversations that we would have,
sentences.zh: 在去学校的路上听到这样的话，虽然让人感到震惊，但这并不是我们平时会有的对话，

sentences.en: it did give me a really good insight into how she was understanding the conversations that we'd been having,
sentences.zh: 但它确实让我深刻地理解了她是如何看待我们一直在进行的那些对话的，

sentences.en: not just between her and I, but also between Evie and her as well and the three of us.
sentences.zh: 不仅是她和我之间的对话，还有埃维与她之间、以及我们三个人之间的对话。

sentences.en: And it was only actually the other day where she'd been hearing, when she hears the word suicide, it does prompt her to ask questions and start to get curious as children do.
sentences.zh: 其实就在前几天，她听到、当她听到“自杀”这个词时，这确实促使她像小孩子那样开始提问并充满好奇心。

sentences.en: She's eight years old.
sentences.zh: 她今年八岁。

sentences.en: And she said to me the other day, mummy, I don't want to know today, but at some point soon, will you tell me how daddy died?
sentences.zh: 前几天她对我说：“妈妈，我今天不想知道，但在不久之后的某个时候，你能告诉我爸爸是怎么死的吗？”

sentences.en: And I said, absolutely, of course I will.
sentences.zh: 我说：“当然可以，我当然会告诉你。”

sentences.en: And then she went off back to her swing or her game that she was playing and that was it.
sentences.zh: 然后她就跑回去玩她的秋千或她正在玩的游戏了，事情就这样过去了。

sentences.en: And I think I'm then left in tears.
sentences.zh: 我想我当时只能独自留下来流泪。

sentences.en: And as I have been over the course of many years on that day where she came up to me and said, for my birthday, could I have my daddy back?
sentences.zh: 就像过去很多年里的那些日子一样——就在她走到我面前对我说“我能不能用爸爸回来作为我的生日礼物？”的那天，我也曾这样流泪。

sentences.en: And I don't know what to say.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该说些什么。

sentences.en: It's overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉太让人崩溃了。

sentences.en: And then 10 seconds later, she says, actually, no, I want a unicorn.
sentences.zh: 然后10秒钟后，她说：“其实不用了，我想要一只独角兽。”

sentences.en: And I'm still crying an hour later because of that initial thing that she's asked for that I can't give her.
sentences.zh: 而一个小时后，我依然在为她最初提出那个我无法满足的请求而哭泣。

sentences.en: But she's moved on.
sentences.zh: 但她已经释怀了、往前走了。

sentences.en: And again, over the years, I've learned how both my children have received this information in different ways and then processed it in their own different ways.
sentences.zh: 同样，这些年来，我也了解到我的两个孩子是如何以不同的方式接受这些信息，并以各自不同的方式去消化它们的。

sentences.en: Evie's much more of a deep thinker.
sentences.zh: 埃维是一个心思更深沉的思考者。

sentences.en: She's a teenager.
sentences.zh: 她已经是个青少年了。

sentences.en: She has a much greater understanding of that permanence of loss and those sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 她对失去的永久性以及诸如此类的事情有着更深刻的理解。

sentences.en: So, yeah, there's a huge difference between the two of them.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，她俩之间有着巨大的差异。

sentences.en: But there is this process that I've come back to time and time again of the different stages that are involved.
sentences.zh: 但其中有一个过程，是我一次又一次回过头去经历的，也就是那些不同的参与阶段。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Such powerful words you've shared with us.
sentences.zh: 你跟我们分享的这些话充满了力量。

sentences.en: And I think I would just echo what you've said, really, about how quickly children can get full up.
sentences.zh: 我想我只想呼应你刚才所说的话，关于孩子们能以多快的速度把自己的小脑袋装满。

sentences.en: And they will take away their little nugget that they've got from you.
sentences.zh: 他们会把从你那里得到的一点点感悟带走。

sentences.en: They will go away and digest that, maybe even across a few sleeps, a few days, a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 他们会离开并去消化这些内容，也许甚至会花上好几个睡眠周期、好几天、好几周的时间。

sentences.en: And then they'll come back to you when you're chopping some cucumber or something and come back to it again, ready for the next installment.
sentences.zh: 然后，当你在切黄瓜或者做什么事情的时候，他们又会突然走过来，再次提起这个话题，准备好迎接接下来的内容。

sentences.en: And I think it's what you've demonstrated so nicely is always holding that open space of being willing to go where they need to, but stopping where they are at.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你表现得非常好的地方在于，你始终保持着一个开放的空间，愿意顺应他们的需要去探讨，但又会在他们当下停下的地方适可而止。

sentences.en: So, you know, you could have said, sure, I'll tell you now, but that's not what she wanted.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，你本可以说“当然，我现在就告诉你”，但那并不是她想要的。

sentences.en: She very quickly communicated and clearly communicated.
sentences.zh: 她非常迅速且清晰地表达了自己的意愿。

sentences.en: I might be ready.
sentences.zh: “我可能已经准备好了。”

sentences.en: I'm intrigued, but I want to know that that's within my control and that you, I guess, can manage that.
sentences.zh: “我对这感到好奇，但我想知道这一切都在我的掌控之中，而且我想你、我猜你也能应付得来。”

sentences.en: Because as they get older, they think about our own kind of looking after us, don't they?
sentences.zh: 因为随着他们渐渐长大，他们也会考虑我们这些做大人的状态、想着照顾我们，不是吗？

sentences.en: And making sure that we're OK and kind of modelling back some of that parenting they've had from us.
sentences.zh: 他们会确保我们没事，并且某种程度上把他们从我们这里得到的那些育儿方式反过来用在我们身上。

sentences.en: That's a really important point.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常重要的观点。

sentences.en: Both of them are empaths, so compassionate, so caring about other people, particularly me.
sentences.zh: 她俩都很有同理心，既富有同情心，又非常关心别人，尤其是关心我。

sentences.en: And they will often avoid saying something or asking something because they don't want to upset me.
sentences.zh: 她们经常会选择不说某些话或不问某些问题，因为她们不想让我难过。

sentences.en: And I'm constantly reminding them that grief is sad.
sentences.zh: 而我则不断地提醒她们，悲伤就是痛苦的。

sentences.en: We can't get away from that.
sentences.zh: 这是我们无法避开的。

sentences.en: It will be upsetting to have these conversations and we will move on afterwards and we will experience joy again.
sentences.zh: 进行这些对话会让人难过，但在此之后我们会继续生活，并且会再次体验到快乐。

sentences.en: And we will do all the things that make us happy.
sentences.zh: 我们会去做所有那些让我们开心的事情。

sentences.en: But we have to have these conversations and we have to accept grief and we have to work through it together.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须进行这些对话，我们必须接受悲伤，并且我们必须一起携手度过难关。

sentences.en: And I recall a really key point as well about trust as well.
sentences.zh: 我也想到了关于信任的一个非常关键的观点。

sentences.en: That I've come across so many people from the experiences and conversations I've had where they've lost a parent many decades ago.
sentences.zh: 根据我的经历和与他人的交流，我遇到了太多这样的人：他们在几十年前失去了父母。

sentences.en: And it was pushed under the carpet and they were told that it was a car accident or, you know,
sentences.zh: 但这件事情被掩盖了下去，他们被告知那是一场车祸，或者，你知道的，

sentences.en: cancer or something because of the shame surrounding suicide and the difficult conversations that people would much rather avoid having.
sentences.zh: 是因为癌症什么的，因为围绕自杀的羞耻感，以及人们宁愿选择避免进行的那些艰难对话。

sentences.en: But then sometime later in life,
sentences.zh: 但后来在人生的某个时刻，

sentences.en: they've discovered the truth and that's completely shattered the trust that they have with those family members that could have been honest with them at the time.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了真相，而这彻底击碎了他们对那些本可以在当时对他们坦诚相待的家庭成员的信任。

sentences.en: And the idea of that truth, that trust being lost between us just terrifies me much more so than having to have honest conversations with them right now.
sentences.zh: 一想到我们之间这种真相和信任可能会丢失，我就感到无比恐惧，这远远超过了现在必须和他们进行坦诚对话所带来的恐惧。

sentences.en: That they seem to take on board unbelievably well.
sentences.zh: 而他们似乎把这些都吸收得好得令人难以置信。

sentences.en: And I've had to learn this as a skill.
sentences.zh: 我不得不把这当作一项技能去学习。

sentences.en: I've had to learn so many different elements of this and know that I can be honest with them and that they will be OK.
sentences.zh: 我不得不学习其中的许多不同要素，并明白我可以对他们坦诚，而且他们会没事的。

sentences.en: And they're growing and thriving and becoming more and more resilient with every conversation that we have and every challenge that they face.
sentences.zh: 随着我们进行的每一次对话以及他们所面对的每一个挑战，他们都在成长、在茁壮成长，并变得越来越具有韧性。

sentences.en: So I try to see these as opportunities to learn and grow and get stronger, even though they're really sad.
sentences.zh: 所以我试着把这些看作是学习、成长和变得更坚强的机会，尽管它们真的很让人悲伤。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think with the sadness.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想还有伴随悲伤而来的情绪。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So my dad died in 2017 when my I think our youngest of very similar ages.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸是在2017年去世的，当时我——我想我们最小的孩子年龄非常相仿。

sentences.en: So he's just turned eight in June.
sentences.zh: 所以他刚在六月份满八岁。

sentences.en: So he was 18 months when my dad died and my eldest was four years old.
sentences.zh: 因此，在我爸爸去世时他只有18个月大，而我的大女儿四岁。

sentences.en: So neither of them actually remember my dad, I don't think.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，她俩其实都不记得我爸爸了。

sentences.en: But, you know, I've always been clear that if they want to talk to me about him and I cry, it isn't them that's made me cry.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我一直向她们明确表态：如果她们想跟我聊起他而我哭了，那并不是因为她们把我弄哭了。

sentences.en: You know, it's the fact that I really loved him.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那是因为我真的很爱他。

sentences.en: I cared about him.
sentences.zh: 我在乎他。

sentences.en: And, you know, when we love someone, we might get upset.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，当我们爱一个人时，我们可能会感到难过。

sentences.en: But it's always OK to have those conversations, even if it makes me cry.
sentences.zh: 但进行这些对话永远都是可以的，即使这会让我哭泣。

sentences.en: Does that make sense?
sentences.zh: 这讲得通吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全讲得通。

sentences.en: And yeah, we're exactly the same.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们的情况完全一样。

sentences.en: I think they they would avoid at all costs anything that would upset me.
sentences.zh: 我想她们会不惜一切代价去避免任何会让我难过的事情。

sentences.en: But I've had to keep on making that point that, like you've said, it's not you that's upsetting me.
sentences.zh: 但我不得不不断地强调一点：正如你所说，把我弄哭的不是你们。

sentences.en: It's a sad thing when someone dies and you'll experience it again and again, unfortunately, as life goes on.
sentences.zh: 当有人去世时，这是一件令人悲伤的事情，而不幸的是，随着生活的继续，你们还会一次又一次地经历这种事。

sentences.en: So we can't avoid these conversations and we can't avoid being sad.
sentences.zh: 所以我们无法避开这些对话，我们也无法避免感到悲伤。

sentences.en: But that that equally means if we if we did try and avoid them, we we'd never talk about that person and we can't do that either.
sentences.zh: 但这同样意味着，如果我们试图避开它们，我们就永远不会谈论那个人，这也是我们做不到的。

sentences.en: So there's never going to be an ideal solution.
sentences.zh: 因此，永远不会存在一个完美的解决方案。

sentences.en: We can't take the pain away and have these conversations.
sentences.zh: 我们无法在消除痛苦的同时又进行这些对话。

sentences.en: So we have to work through it in the best way that we can.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须以我们所能做到的最好方式来共同度过难关。

sentences.en: And I think that's where we've reached between the three of us.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我们三个人目前所达到的状态。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: And I think one of the differences with suicide.
sentences.zh: 我想，自杀所带来的不同之处之一在于……

sentences.en: So in the grief collective, somebody talks about suicide as being like pouring acid on the wounds of grief because it kind of amplifies everything.
sentences.zh: 所以在悲伤互助群体（grief collective）里，有人把自杀比作在悲伤的伤口上泼洒酸液，因为它会放大一切。

sentences.en: And it also takes away the opportunity to do some of the things I recommend with children.
sentences.zh: 它同时也剥夺了你去采取我推荐给孩子们的某些做法的机会。

sentences.en: If you have got someone who's very unwell and a death is expected that actually when you when they're super young,
sentences.zh: 如果你身边有人病得很重，并且预料到会有死亡的发生，实际上，当他们还非常年幼的时候，

sentences.en: you sit and watch the Bing Bunny butterfly episode, for example, and that you start to as you're walking along
sentences.zh: 你可以坐下来看《小飞兔（Bing Bunny）》的蝴蝶那一集，举个例子，当你走在路上时，

sentences.en: and you see a dead mouse or a dead pigeon or a dead insect, that you start to stop and take a look and actually think about the processes involved with a death
sentences.zh: 如果你看到了一只死老鼠、死鸽子或死昆虫，你可以停下来看一看，去思考与死亡相关的那些过程，

sentences.en: and that it's permanent and that we don't come back, that it's not like the cartoons.
sentences.zh: 明白死亡是永久的，我们不会再回来，它不像动画片里那样。

sentences.en: We're not magically reappearing.
sentences.zh: 我们不会像变魔术一样再次出现。

sentences.en: And I think what you lose with a suicide as well is so much of that preparation that you you're not mentioning.
sentences.zh: 我认为你在面对自杀时所失去的，也是很大一部分那种你没有提及的心理准备。

sentences.en: Perhaps I didn't mention that Grampy was going to die, but I'm making sure that my children have a developmental understanding of death.
sentences.zh: 也许我没有提到爷爷会死，但我正在确保我的孩子们对发展心理学层面的死亡有所理解。

sentences.en: And I'm not using words like poorly, because then when I say, oh, baby, are you feeling poorly?
sentences.zh: 我没有使用“身体不舒服（poorly）”这样的词，因为当我以后说“哦，宝贝，你觉得身体不舒服吗？”时，

sentences.en: They then begin to think, gosh, I'm going to die.
sentences.zh: 他们就会开始想：“天哪，我要死了。”

sentences.en: You know, we're being, like you said, quite matter of fact with our words and and leaving them space to talk and to be curious.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像你所说的那样，我们在用词上相当客观实在，并为他们留出空间去交谈、去保持好奇心。

sentences.en: Um, and I think that's so important, but it's then trying to kind of retrofit that in a suicide, which is so, so extra, extra challenging.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这非常重要，但要在自杀这种情况下事后去弥补这一点，是非常、非常、极其具有挑战性的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I think, like you said at the start there, I've heard suicide described as grief with the volume turned up.
sentences.zh: 我想，正如你一开始所说的那样，我曾听人把自杀描述为“把音量开到最大的悲伤”。

sentences.en: And it absolutely is.
sentences.zh: 它绝对就是这样。

sentences.en: And the different extra emotions and challenges that it that it brings.
sentences.zh: 它带来了各种额外的情绪和挑战。

sentences.en: But, yeah, you don't have that opportunity to prepare.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，你确实没有机会去做准备。

sentences.en: But I guess that's the same with sudden accidents and those sorts of things as well.
sentences.zh: 不过我想，突发的事故以及诸如此类的事情也是一样的。

sentences.en: And I think perhaps it's a responsibility for us as parents to to consider this at some point anyway.
sentences.zh: 我想，无论如何，这也许是我们作为父母需要去思考的责任。

sentences.en: I mean, Evie in particular had experienced the loss of several grandparents.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，埃维尤其经历了几位祖辈的离世。

sentences.en: So she was conscious of the concept of death and people no longer being around, but nobody as close as her dad.
sentences.zh: 所以她对死亡的概念以及人们不再陪伴在身边这件事是有意识的，但没有人像她爸爸那样亲近。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it was it was very much a retrofit.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这在很大程度上是一种事后的补救。

sentences.en: And it's it's those conversations afterwards that that lead more into into topics like mental health and self-care and taking care of ourselves so we don't end up in a similar position.
sentences.zh: 正是之后的那些对话，引领着我们走向更多关于心理健康、自我关爱以及照顾好我们自己的话题，这样我们才不会落入类似的境地。

sentences.en: I think one of the other complications with suicide is those statistics around people who have lost a loved one to suicide are more susceptible to mental health issues themselves and ultimately taking their own lives or at least considering it.
sentences.zh: 我认为自杀带来的另一个复杂之处在于，那些因亲人自杀离世而遭受打击的人，相关的统计数据表明他们自身也更容易受到心理健康问题的困扰，并最终选择结束自己的生命，或者至少考虑过这么做。

sentences.en: And so are their children.
sentences.zh: 他们的孩子也是如此。

sentences.en: There's studies to suggest that children who've lost a parent to suicide are three times more likely to take their own lives at some point.
sentences.zh: 有研究表明，失去了因自杀离世的父母的孩子，在某个时刻选择结束自己生命的几率要高出三倍。

sentences.en: And these statistics terrify me.
sentences.zh: 这些统计数据让我感到惊恐。

sentences.en: So rather than talking about the death quite so much, we talk about the need to take care of ourselves in in an age appropriate way.
sentences.zh: 因此，与其过多地谈论死亡，我们开始以一种适合他们年龄的方式，谈论照顾好我们自己的必要性。

sentences.en: And they do things like this at school as well.
sentences.zh: 他们在学校里也会做类似的事情。

sentences.en: But, yeah, we're constantly talking about needing to make sure we're being gentle with ourselves and being conscious of our emotions and all of those sorts of things,
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我们一直在谈论需要确保我们善待自己、对自己的情绪保持觉察以及所有诸如此类的事情，

sentences.en: which I don't think I would have considered had this not happened.
sentences.zh: 如果不是发生了这件事，我想我是不会去考虑这些的。

sentences.en: And I think if I'm desperately scrabbling around for a silver lining here,
sentences.zh: 如果我非要拼命在其中寻找一丝光明的话，

sentences.en: it's that fact that both my children are very conscious of the dangers of poor mental health and poor well-being, poor physical well-being, all those sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 那就是我的两个孩子都对心理健康不佳、幸福感不佳、身体健康不佳以及所有这些事情所带来的危险有着高度的觉察。

sentences.en: And the absolute paramount need to look after ourselves and look after one another.
sentences.zh: 并且他们深深地明白照顾好自己以及照顾好彼此是至关重要的事情。

sentences.en: Evie has since become a mental health ambassador at school,
sentences.zh: 埃维后来成了学校里的心理健康大使，

sentences.en: and she goes talking to primary schools and assemblies and things as part of this role to younger children on the subject of mental health and how we should be looking after ourselves.
sentences.zh: 作为这个角色的一部分，她去小学和全校集会上与年幼的孩子们谈论心理健康以及我们应该如何照顾好自己。

sentences.en: And that, I don't think, is something that she would have done had this not happened.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果不是发生了这件事，她大概是不会去做这些事情的。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: I'm so proud of her and what she's creating.
sentences.zh: 我为她以及她所创造的一切感到无比骄傲。

sentences.en: I know you shared a little short film with me that she'd been part of making as well, and it was so incredibly powerful.
sentences.zh: 我知道你跟我分享过一小段她参与制作的短片，真的是非常有感染力。

sentences.en: You know, it's shaping these little young lives, but hopefully in a way that feels like it's building them as well.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这正在塑造这些年轻的生命，但希望这种塑造的方式也能让他们内心变得更强大。

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that resilience, because the world's a tough place at times, as we know, and unfortunately it's something they need to know too.
sentences.zh: 还有那种韧性，因为正如我们所知，世界有时是一个严酷的地方，而不幸的是这也是他们需要了解的事情。

sentences.en: But yeah, the animation that Evie was part of creating came about from some challenges she was having when she first started at senior school when she was 11.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，埃维参与制作的那部动画片，源于她11岁刚上高中时遇到的一些挑战。

sentences.en: And she would hear people kind of laughing and joking about the topic of suicide, saying, you know, I'll kill myself if I've got to sit through another lesson like that.
sentences.zh: 当时她会听到人们把自杀这个话题当成笑话来开玩笑，说：“如果我非得再上一节这样的课，我就去自杀。”

sentences.en: Or kids would use that acronym KYS when they're messaging each other, suggesting they should, you know, kill yourself when they've done something embarrassing, which is horrendous.
sentences.zh: 或者孩子们在发信息时会使用KYS这个缩写，当别人做了什么尴尬的事情时暗示对方“去自杀吧”，这太可怕了。

sentences.en: And it would be so upsetting for her.
sentences.zh: 这会让她感到非常难过。

sentences.en: So she wrote a story about it and she was really brave and she approached the head of year at the school she was at at the time and shared this story with them.
sentences.zh: 于是她为此写了一个故事，并且非常勇敢地找到了她当时所在学校的年级主任，把这个故事分享给了他们。

sentences.en: And they read it out at an assembly.
sentences.zh: 他们还在一次全校集会上宣读了这个故事。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, it didn't have any impact at all.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，它没有产生任何影响。

sentences.en: And I think there were other elements of this school that we weren't too keen on when we when we first spoke to them about her going there and the extra support that she might need.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这所学校还有其他一些方面，在我们最初跟他们交流她去那里上学以及她可能需要的额外支持时，我们并不是很满意。

sentences.en: And they talked about all of the different facilities that they have to kind of safeguard children and all the well-being facilities that they have.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到了他们拥有的各种旨在保护儿童的设施，以及他们所有的心理关怀设施。

sentences.en: They didn't seem to pan out.
sentences.zh: 但那些似乎并没有兑现。

sentences.en: It felt like there was perhaps a little bit of lip service there.
sentences.zh: 感觉他们或许只是在敷衍了事。

sentences.en: So anyway, this this story didn't land as Evie had hoped.
sentences.zh: 总之，这个故事并没有像埃维希望的那样引起反响。

sentences.en: And I mentioned that to some of my colleagues at work.
sentences.zh: 我跟工作中的一些同事提过这件事。

sentences.en: I work for a creative agency where there's some very clever animators and illustrators.
sentences.zh: 我在一家创意机构工作，里面有一些非常聪明的动画师和插画师。

sentences.en: And they took Evie's story and turned it into a beautiful animation with stunning illustration and music.
sentences.zh: 他们采用了埃维的故事，将其变成了一部精美的动画，配以惊艳的插画和音乐。

sentences.en: And it was there was a voiceover recorded for it as well.
sentences.zh: 里面还录制了画外音。

sentences.en: And while they while that was being done, Evie was finding this school more and more of a challenge for various reasons.
sentences.zh: 就在制作期间，由于各种原因，埃维发现这所学校对她而言越来越充满挑战。

sentences.en: And I moved her to a different school where she immediately began to thrive.
sentences.zh: 于是我给她转到了一所不同的学校，她在那里很快就开始如鱼得水。

sentences.en: And this is where she became a mental health ambassador and started just getting stuck into all of these different roles.
sentences.zh: 正是在这里，她成为了一名心理健康大使，开始积极投入到所有这些不同的角色中。

sentences.en: There's an amazing well-being centre where she can go at any point during the day and feel that sense of safety around her with people that she knows and trusts,
sentences.zh: 这里有一个令人惊叹的心理关怀中心，她可以在一天的任何时候去那里，在自己认识并信任的人身边感受到那种安全感，

sentences.en: whether that's teachers or fellow students.
sentences.zh: 无论是老师还是同学。

sentences.en: And I think from the very top, from the senior leadership at the school, from the head down, they take it seriously.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为从最高层开始，从学校的高级领导层，从校长到所有人，他们都很重视这件事。

sentences.en: The whole subject of emotional well-being and mental health.
sentences.zh: 情感关怀和心理健康这个宏观主题。

sentences.en: It's built into everything that they they do, everything that they teach.
sentences.zh: 它已经融入了他们所做的每一件事、所教的每一堂课中。

sentences.en: And it's certainly not any there's no lip service there whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 而且这绝对不是在敷衍，一点也没有。

sentences.en: However, so Evie has now introduced the animation to this school and had an amazing response to it.
sentences.zh: 然而，埃维现在已经把这部动画带到了这所学校，并获得了热烈的反响。

sentences.en: I've shared it on my social channels and it's now being shown across the country in schools, in assemblies.
sentences.zh: 我把它分享到了我的社交渠道上，现在它正在全国各地的学校、晨会上播放。

sentences.en: It's being added to the curriculums of different schools across the country.
sentences.zh: 它正被加入全国各地不同学校的课程中。

sentences.en: But there's also other settings and environments that are using it.
sentences.zh: 但也有其他机构和环境在使用它。

sentences.en: So the NHS have built it into their nursing inductions in certain hospital trusts.
sentences.zh: 比如国民保健署（NHS）已将其纳入某些医院信托机构的护士入职培训中。

sentences.en: Different grief charities are using it.
sentences.zh: 不同的悲痛援助慈善机构正在使用它。

sentences.en: First aid, mental health first aiders are using it in workplaces and line managers using it with their training and those sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 急救人员、心理健康急救员在工作场所使用它，直线经理在培训中以及类似场景下也在使用它。

sentences.en: And it's all around this kind of sensitivity of language on the subject of suicide, whether that's for a child or for an adult.
sentences.zh: 这一切都围绕着在自杀这个话题上语言的敏感性，无论是针对儿童还是成人。

sentences.en: And that I am ridiculously proud of, with Evie being the instigator of this and the one that made all that happen.
sentences.zh: 对此我感到无比自豪，埃维是这一切的发起者，也是让这一切成为现实的人。

sentences.en: Words, they can tumble out, as quiet as a whisper, or as loud as a shout.
sentences.zh: 言语，它们可能会倾泻而出，轻柔如耳语，响亮如呐喊。

sentences.en: Words, they can be mean, hurtful comments or messages on a screen.
sentences.zh: 言语，它们可能是刻薄、伤人的评论或屏幕上的信息。

sentences.en: Words, they can make us cry, especially when a loved one has died through suicide.
sentences.zh: 言语，它们能让我们痛哭流涕，尤其是当挚爱因自杀离去时。

sentences.en: Here's a letter full of words, written by a girl whose dad is now a blackbird.
sentences.zh: 这里有一封写满言语的信，由一个女孩写下，她的爸爸如今成了一只乌鸫。

sentences.en: There was a time when I had two parents.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，我拥有双亲。

sentences.en: I was young and I was confident that was the way life would be for us.
sentences.zh: 我很小，并且坚信生活本该如此。

sentences.en: But one day I got pulled out of class and saw my mum walking towards the school with my godmother.
sentences.zh: 但有一天，我被叫出课堂，看到妈妈和我的教母正朝学校走来。

sentences.en: I was confused when I saw my mum's tear-stained face.
sentences.zh: 看到妈妈满脸泪痕，我很困惑。

sentences.en: She told me that my dad hadn't shown up for work and, before anyone realised he was missing, he had died by suicide.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，爸爸没有去上班，在大家意识到他失踪之前，他已经自杀身亡了。

sentences.en: This was the biggest shock of our lives.
sentences.zh: 这是我们一生中最大的打击。

sentences.en: He had seemed pretty happy with life and had never mentioned feeling depressed.
sentences.zh: 他看起来对生活挺满意，从未提过自己感到沮丧。

sentences.en: So it took months for me to even accept what had happened.
sentences.zh: 因此，我花了几个月的时间才勉强接受发生的一切。

sentences.en: It took many more after that, for me to stop feeling guilty.
sentences.zh: 在此之后又过了好久，我才停止自责。

sentences.en: Every time I listened to the songs he liked to sing along to.
sentences.zh: 每当我听到他生前喜欢跟着一起唱的歌时。

sentences.en: I've missed out on summer holidays at the beach with him.
sentences.zh: 我错过了与他在海滩度过的夏日假期。

sentences.en: I've missed out on having him in the audience at school shows.
sentences.zh: 我错过了他在学校演出观众席中的陪伴。

sentences.en: We've all missed out.
sentences.zh: 我们都错过了。

sentences.en: So has dad.
sentences.zh: 爸爸也是。

sentences.en: I'm telling you this because I've heard jokes about suicide and depression at school.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为我在学校听到过关于自杀和抑郁的笑话。

sentences.en: And this has really hurt me.
sentences.zh: 这真的深深伤害了我。

sentences.en: Take it from me.
sentences.zh: 听我的劝。

sentences.en: Suicide isn't funny.
sentences.zh: 自杀一点也不好笑。

sentences.en: It's not something to laugh and joke about.
sentences.zh: 这不是拿来取笑和开玩笑的事。

sentences.en: You may not know it, but your words can really upset people who have been affected by suicide.
sentences.zh: 你可能不知道，你的话真的会惹恼那些受过自杀影响的人。

sentences.en: It's tough, you know, to hear people laughing about something that completely turned my world upside down.
sentences.zh: 听着别人嘲笑那些彻底颠覆我世界的事情，真的很难受，你知道的。

sentences.en: My dad died a few years ago now.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸在几年前去世了。

sentences.en: But the memories of what happened are still a huge part of my daily life.
sentences.zh: 但当时的记忆依然是我日常生活中的巨大一部分。

sentences.en: Words matter.
sentences.zh: 言语很重要。

sentences.en: So think before you speak.
sentences.zh: 所以开口前请三思。

sentences.en: Please, make kindness a promise that you keep.
sentences.zh: 拜托，把善良当作你坚守的诺言。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: As a mummy, a fellow human, it just brings shivers down my spine.
sentences.zh: 作为一位母亲，作为一个同类，这真的让我不寒而栗。

sentences.en: It's amazing stuff.
sentences.zh: 这太了不起了。

sentences.en: And I just wanted to talk to your fear, really.
sentences.zh: 我其实只是想针对你的恐惧聊一聊。

sentences.en: So speaking as a qualified clinical psychologist who specializes in complex trauma and grief,
sentences.zh: 那么，作为一名专注于复杂创伤和悲痛的合格临床心理学家，

sentences.en: I would say that the stats for increased probability of someone ending their own life when it's been in their family
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，当家庭中曾发生过自杀时，个人结束自己生命的可能性增加的统计数据

sentences.en: is probably going to be in families where it's been shame-filled and not spoken about
sentences.zh: 很可能出现在那些充满羞耻感、对此避而不谈的家庭中，

sentences.en: and where they've not been able to really express their emotions and ask questions without fear of the reaction, the response, or that they might be in trouble.
sentences.zh: 在这些家庭里，他们无法真正表达自己的情绪，也无法在提问时免于对反应、答复或惹麻烦的恐惧。

sentences.en: And I think that what I know about mitigating factors, you are doing in abundance.
sentences.zh: 我认为，关于那些缓解因素，你已经在大量地做了。

sentences.en: And what we know is it's the difference, being the difference that makes the difference for children
sentences.zh: 我们知道的是，这是至关重要的一点，是那个能够为孩子们带来改变的改变因素，

sentences.en: and always knowing that they've got that safe space that's non-judgmental, that's compassionate, that they can bring their best selves to, but also their worst selves.
sentences.zh: 并且始终让他们知道，他们拥有一个不带评判、充满同情心的安全空间，在那里他们可以展现最好的自己，也可以展现最糟的自己。

sentences.en: And I often think with my children, you know, I will always love you.
sentences.zh: 我经常对我的孩子们想，你知道的，我永远爱你们。

sentences.en: I don't always like your behavior, but you can always talk to me, whatever you're worried about.
sentences.zh: 我并不总是喜欢你们的行为，但无论你们在担心什么，你们随时都可以跟我谈。

sentences.en: And that mitigates so much to the extent where I would say it mitigates it to kind of minimal.
sentences.zh: 这在很大程度上起到了缓解作用，甚至可以说它把这种风险降到了最低程度。

sentences.en: So I don't know if that's useful at all.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道这到底有没有用。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对有用。

sentences.en: It's, as I said earlier, it's been a huge worry for me that because their own father took his life, it could almost normalize it to a point where it becomes an option for them
sentences.zh: 正如我刚才所说，我一直非常担心，因为他们的亲生父亲轻生了，这几乎会使它正常化，直到它对他们来说变成了一种选择，

sentences.en: or they believe that it's an option for me if I'm having a bad day or I'm reacting badly to something that's happened or I'm upset about something.
sentences.zh: 或者让他们觉得，如果我正经历糟糕的一天，或者对发生的某事反应过激，或者为某事感到心烦意乱，这也是我可以选择的一条路。

sentences.en: And I've worked very hard and researched a huge amount on how to mitigate that.
sentences.zh: 我付出了巨大的努力，研究了大量关于如何缓解这一问题的方法。

sentences.en: We can never remove it completely because suicide is something that exists one way or another.
sentences.zh: 我们永远无法彻底根除它，因为自杀总会以这样或那样的方式存在。

sentences.en: But I'm almost hopeful that through the experience we've had, we can go the other way and we can learn that suicide, yes, it might be an option,
sentences.zh: 但我几乎抱有希望，通过我们所经历的一切，我们可以走向另一个方向，并且明白自杀，是的，它或许是一种选择，

sentences.en: but there are a huge number of other things that we can look into doing that we are much more conscious and aware of as a family now
sentences.zh: 但我们还可以做大量其他的事情，作为一家人，我们现在对此有了更多的意识和觉察，

sentences.en: that we otherwise wouldn't have been, wouldn't have known about.
sentences.zh: 而这些是我们原本不会知道、不会去了解的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I'm hopeful that it's always okay to ask for help, always.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我希望能够随时寻求帮助，永远都可以。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对的。

sentences.en: And I think that there's a lot of people around, well, I wouldn't say there's a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为周围有很多人——嗯，我也不能说有很多人。

sentences.en: I mean, there's a few people around me that reinforce that message.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我身边有几个人在强化这个信息。

sentences.en: My best friend, for example, who is the girl's godmother, checks in with them regularly
sentences.zh: 比如我的闺蜜，也就是两个女孩的教母，她会定期关照她们，

sentences.en: and she'll do it in a way that works for them.
sentences.zh: 而且她会用对她们有效的方式去做。

sentences.en: So she'll send them a WhatsApp or, you know, see that they've been on Instagram recently or Evie has at least and send something funny to her
sentences.zh: 所以她会给她们发WhatsApp，或者，你知道的，看到她们最近登录过Instagram——至少埃维是这样——然后发给埃维一些有趣的东西，

sentences.en: or something that relates to a conversation we might have had.
sentences.zh: 或者与我们可能进行过的对话相关的东西。

sentences.en: So we're kind of learning to operate on their level as well and have these conversations that they can relate to
sentences.zh: 所以我们也在学着调整到她们的频道来互动，进行那些她们能产生共鸣的对话，

sentences.en: without turning into, like, embarrassing parent mode and trying to use language that just wouldn't work.
sentences.zh: 而不是变成那种令人尴尬的家长模式，去使用根本不管用的语言。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's a constant journey that I'm on and I'm lucky to have support from a few good people with too.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这是一段我正在经历的漫长旅程，我很幸运能得到几位好心人的支持。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm so pleased to hear that you're well supported.
sentences.zh: 很高兴听到你得到了很好的支持。

sentences.en: Talking about language, could you tell us about how the concept of Daddy Blackbird came around?
sentences.zh: 说起语言，能跟我们讲讲“乌鸫爸爸”这个概念是怎么来的吗？

sentences.en: I can.
sentences.zh: 可以的。

sentences.en: I'm glad you asked about that because it's a very special thing to me.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你问起这个，因为这对我很特别。

sentences.en: So I'm not particularly religious.
sentences.zh: 我不算特别有宗教信仰。

sentences.en: I don't believe in reincarnation, but I'm open-minded about the whole concept.
sentences.zh: 我不相信轮回转世，但对整个概念保持开放的心态。

sentences.en: And shortly after Steve died, there was a little boy blackbird that would always be in the back garden.
sentences.zh: 在史蒂夫去世后不久，后花园里总会有一只小乌鸫。

sentences.en: And I'd started to notice that he would kind of hop right up to the back door, which was unusual.
sentences.zh: 我开始注意到它会一路蹦跳着来到后门，这很不寻常。

sentences.en: But, you know, I was too busy thinking about other things to think much of that.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我当时忙着想别的事，没怎么把这放在心上。

sentences.en: But there were times when I'd think back to how Steve would talk about his mum and some of the beliefs that she had around kind of an older relative who had died
sentences.zh: 不过有时我会回想起史蒂夫是如何谈论他的母亲的，以及她的一些信念，比如关于某个去世的年长亲戚，

sentences.en: and maybe had come back to visit as a bird or something.
sentences.zh: 或许曾化身为一只鸟或其他什么回来探望。

sentences.en: And my mum, again, not particularly into things like reincarnation, but when she'd see a butterfly, it would make her think of her mum and bring her some comfort.
sentences.zh: 我的母亲同样对轮回转世之类的不太感冒，但每当她看到一只蝴蝶，就会让她想起自己的母亲，并给她带来一些安慰。

sentences.en: So I started to look at this blackbird that was hobbling around the garden all the time.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始关注这只整天在花园里蹒跚学步的乌鸫。

sentences.en: And for some reason, I started referring to him as Daddy Blackbird.
sentences.zh: 不知为何，我开始称它为乌鸫爸爸。

sentences.en: And I'd call the girls over and say,
sentences.zh: 我会把女孩们叫过来，说：

sentences.en: Look, Daddy Blackbird's come to visit.
sentences.zh: 看，乌鸫爸爸来看我们了。

sentences.en: It almost felt like something nice to just say in amongst all the horror and sorrow.
sentences.zh: 在所有的恐怖和悲伤之中，说出这样一句话倒让人感觉挺温馨的。

sentences.en: And they'd get quite excited to see him.
sentences.zh: 她们看到它会感到相当兴奋。

sentences.en: And there were times when I'd be a bit pissed off when he turned up because I was busy washing up and doing all the millions of jobs
sentences.zh: 有时它出现时我还会觉得有点烦，因为我正忙着洗碗以及做那些成百万件的工作，

sentences.en: that Steve would have been doing had he been there.
sentences.zh: 如果史蒂夫还在的话，这些本该由他来做。

sentences.en: And instead, that's potentially him hopping around and flying around free as a bird.
sentences.zh: 而相反，那可能只是他在周围蹦来跳去、像鸟儿一样自由飞翔。

sentences.en: But no, over time, I sort of developed this odd relationship where I'd be happy to see him in the back garden and I'd feel a sense of comfort when I did.
sentences.zh: 不过随着时间的推移，我逐渐和它发展出了一种奇妙的关系，在后花园看到它时我会很高兴，看到它时我会有种被安慰的感觉。

sentences.en: And I was able to bring him into conversation with the girls as well.
sentences.zh: 我也能够把它的故事带入到我和女孩们的对话中。

sentences.en: And then there were long periods of time where we wouldn't see him, but he always seems to come back.
sentences.zh: 有时我们会很长时间看不到它，但它似乎总会回来。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if it's the same blackbird, but it doesn't really bother me either way.
sentences.zh: 我不确定是不是同一只乌鸫，但无论是哪只对我来说都无所谓。

sentences.en: It's more around what it symbolises.
sentences.zh: 这更多关乎它所象征的意义。

sentences.en: And on Steve's first birthday after he died, we went to a garden centre and we bought a china blackbird to put in the garden to fill those gaps
sentences.zh: 在史蒂夫去世后的第一个生日，我们去了一家园艺中心，买了一只陶瓷乌鸫放在花园里，用来填补

sentences.en: when the real daddy blackbird isn't around.
sentences.zh: 真正的乌鸫爸爸不在时的空缺。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, I'd been kind of starting to write about my experiences just to get it out of my head and onto a piece of paper because writing is a passion for me.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我开始记录自己的经历，只是为了把它从脑子里倒腾到纸上，因为写作是我的热情所在。

sentences.en: And I realised when I looked at what I'd written, it was almost like a series of chapters.
sentences.zh: 当我审视自己写下的文字时，我意识到这几乎就像是一系列章节。

sentences.en: And then I realised that a series of chapters actually sort of represents a book.
sentences.zh: 然后我意识到，一系列章节实际上就代表了一本书。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, when people were saying to me, you should write a book about everything you've been through.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，当人们对我说“你应该把你经历的一切写成一本书”时，

sentences.en: I thought, oh, I think I have.
sentences.zh: 我想，哦，我想我已经写了。

sentences.en: Or at least I've started to.
sentences.zh: 或者至少我已经开始了。

sentences.en: So I continued with that.
sentences.zh: 所以我继续写下去。

sentences.en: And there seemed to be only one title that I could give this book.
sentences.zh: 这本书似乎只能有一个名字。

sentences.en: And it was Daddy Blackbird.
sentences.zh: 那就是《乌鸫爸爸》。

sentences.en: And it's in three sections.
sentences.zh: 它分为三个部分。

sentences.en: It talks about the history of how we first got together and some of the amazing adventures that we had together as well as some of the challenges that we faced together.
sentences.zh: 它讲述了我们最初如何走到一起的历史，我们共同经历的一些奇妙冒险，以及我们共同面对的一些挑战。

sentences.en: It talks about the horror, obviously, when Steve died and all the things that came after that.
sentences.zh: 它显然讲述了史蒂夫去世时的恐怖场景以及随之而来的一切。

sentences.en: And then the third section is about the hope and all of the lessons that I've learnt that I want to share with other people, particularly people in a position like me.
sentences.zh: 然后第三部分是关于希望以及我学到的所有我想与他人分享的经验教训，特别是那些处境和我相似的人。

sentences.en: And I've broken that down into three different sections.
sentences.zh: 我把它分成了三个不同的部分。

sentences.en: And it's what I call my triangle of recovery.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所说的“康复金字塔”。

sentences.en: So I talk about the power of me and how I've drawn on the strengths I had already, but also developed new strengths and skills.
sentences.zh: 所以我谈到了“我的力量”，以及我是如何汲取自己原有的力量，并培养新的力量和技能的。

sentences.en: Then there's the power of my children, which I've spoken about in depth and taking strength from seeing their resilience grow and thrive and all the amazing things
sentences.zh: 接下来是“孩子们的 pentru”（此处应为译文：孩子们的力量），我对此进行了深入探讨，从见证他们的韧性成长、茁壮繁衍以及他们取得的所有惊人成就中汲取力量，

sentences.en: that they're achieving.
sentences.zh: 这些成就令人瞩目。

sentences.en: And then the last part of that is the power of my community and the people around me that have supported me from day one, but also the new connections and relationships
sentences.zh: 最后一部分是“社区的力量”，包括从第一天起就支持我周围的人，以及我在近期建立的新人脉和新关系。

sentences.en: I've built in more recent times.
sentences.zh: 然后，是的，《乌鸫爸爸》现在对我来说是一件非常特别的事，不仅是每天来花园做客的那只真实的鸟，还有我几乎已经完成的书。

sentences.en: And, yeah, Daddy Blackbird is now a very special thing to me, not just the actual bird that visits every day in the garden, but the book that I've almost completed now.
sentences.zh: 好吧，听起来这是一本非常值得一读的书。

sentences.en: Well, it sounds like it's a great read.
sentences.zh: 你会说这是针对成年人的吗？

sentences.en: Is that aimed at adults, would you say?
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为它是面向成年人的。

sentences.en: Yes, I would say it is aimed at adults.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，主要针对那些经历过与我相同遭遇的人，但我发现在分享我所有的不同经历、故事以及那些小插曲时，

sentences.en: Mainly, as I say, for people that have been through what I have, but I've found in sharing all my different experiences and stories and the little anecdotes
sentences.zh: 它们能帮助人们理解失去至亲因自杀而离去是什么感觉。

sentences.en: that help people understand what it's like to lose somebody to suicide.
sentences.zh: 我想有许多人联系我，说这本书帮助他们度过了一段曾经考虑自杀的困难时期。

sentences.en: I think I've had so many people contact me to say that it's helped them get through a difficult period where they'd perhaps been considering suicide.
sentences.zh: 当他们读到对留下的人所造成的惨痛影响时，他们或许开始思考可以采取的替代做法。

sentences.en: And then when they read about the horrific impact on the people left behind, they've perhaps started to think about alternative things that they can do.
sentences.zh: 这真的是充满力量的。

sentences.en: And that is really powerful.
sentences.zh: 所以这是另一类能从阅读我的书中获得巨大益处的人群。

sentences.en: So that's another group of people that would greatly benefit from reading my book.
sentences.zh: 这才是最重要的。

sentences.en: But yeah, parents like me who have had to struggle with their own personal loss, but also the loss of their children and how to deal with that
sentences.zh: 但没错，像我这样经历过自身痛苦，还要经历失去孩子的痛苦以及如何应对这一切的父母

sentences.en: and the things I've got wrong that didn't work or the things that I've learned that really have worked and the place we're in now and just that message that it's hell
sentences.zh: 以及我曾做错的、行不通的事情，或是真正学到并奏效的方法，我们现在的处境，以及这样一个信息：这真是一场煎熬

sentences.en: and you will go through the worst times.
sentences.zh: 而你们将会经历最艰难的时刻。

sentences.en: And we had COVID to deal with as well and amongst all of that.
sentences.zh: 而且在那期间，我们还要应对新冠疫情。

sentences.en: But there's hope.
sentences.zh: 但希望依然存在。

sentences.en: And I remember one line in particular that I've included my book from a therapist that I saw once when I first spoke to her and she recognised that I was lacking
sentences.zh: 我记得我曾在书里引用过一位治疗师说过的一句话。有一次我刚跟她交谈时，她觉察到我缺乏

sentences.en: in any sense of optimism.
sentences.zh: 任何意义上的乐观。

sentences.en: And she said to me, I will carry hope for you until you're ready to carry it for yourself.
sentences.zh: 她对我说：“我会替你怀揣希望，直到你准备好自己去承担。”

sentences.en: And I will never forget those words.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记这些话。

sentences.en: And I hope that my book does something similar for at least one person and carries some hope for them
sentences.zh: 我希望我的书也能对至少一个人起到类似的作用，为他们承载一些希望

sentences.en: until a time where they can actually feel it themselves.
sentences.zh: 直到他们能够真正亲身感受到希望的那一天。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Such powerful words.
sentences.zh: 多么有力量的话语。

sentences.en: And is it available on Amazon?
sentences.zh: 这本书能在亚马逊上买到吗？

sentences.en: It will be available on Amazon at the beginning of October.
sentences.zh: 它将在十月初在亚马逊上架。

sentences.en: My intention is to publish it on World Mental Health Day, which is the 10th of October.
sentences.zh: 我的计划是在世界精神卫生日（也就是10月10日）出版它。

sentences.en: I do have a website where I've got some free chapters available to have a read of now though.
sentences.zh: 不过我确实有一个网站，上面有一些免费章节现在就可以阅读。

sentences.en: So you can get an idea of whether it's something you want to know more about.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以了解一下这是否是你想要深入了解的内容。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: What's your website?
sentences.zh: 你的网站是什么？

sentences.en: It's DaddyBlackbird, www.daddyblackbird.com.
sentences.zh: It's DaddyBlackbird, www.daddyblackbird.com.

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: And sort of throughout our discussion, there's been lots of different themes.
sentences.zh: 在我们的讨论中，贯穿着许多不同的主题。

sentences.en: And the one that we've kind of alluded to but not mentioned is anger.
sentences.zh: 其中一个我们有所暗示但没有明说的主题就是愤怒。

sentences.en: You know, and I think that came through quite strongly when you were talking about Daddy Blackbird hopping about the garden.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我觉得当你谈到黑鸟爸爸在花园里蹦蹦跳跳时，这一点表现得相当强烈。

sentences.en: And anger is such a normal part of the grief process.
sentences.zh: 愤怒是悲伤过程中非常正常的一部分。

sentences.en: But I think with suicide, it can really feel amplified as well.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，对于自杀而言，这种感觉甚至会被无限放大。

sentences.en: And then you can feel kind of very conflicted for feeling anger towards somebody that's died.
sentences.zh: 然后，当你对一个已经离世的人感到愤怒时，你会感到非常矛盾。

sentences.en: But anger is a very important human emotion.
sentences.zh: 但愤怒是一种非常重要的人类情感。

sentences.en: And it's understandable that we would be feeling that.
sentences.zh: 我们会有这种感觉是完全可以理解的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Anger is something that I've felt from day one, particularly when I see how sad my children are.
sentences.zh: 愤怒是我从第一天起就感受到的情绪，特别是当我看到我的孩子们是多么伤心的时候。

sentences.en: And when I'm struggling in the middle of the night with a poorly child on my own, or there are moments where Steve should be there and isn't.
sentences.zh: 当我在半夜独自一人艰难地照顾生病的孩子，或者在某些时刻史蒂夫本该在场却不在时。

sentences.en: And I'm angry because he didn't share with me his issues and challenges that led him to where he was.
sentences.zh: 我很愤怒，因为他没有和我分享他的问题以及将他推向绝境的挑战。

sentences.en: I'm angry for this sense of abandonment that I feel for me and for my children.
sentences.zh: 我为自己和孩子们感到的这种被抛弃感而愤怒。

sentences.en: There's so many reasons why I'm angry.
sentences.zh: 我感到愤怒的原因有太多太多。

sentences.en: And the anger has led me to some very dark places over time and some very unhealthy habits as well, which have not worked well for me.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，愤怒将我带向了一些非常黑暗的境地，也让我养成了一些非常不健康的习惯，这对我的状况毫无益处。

sentences.en: And again, I've come out the other side of those and hopefully others can learn from those too.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我已经从那些阴霾中走了出来，希望其他人也能从中汲取教训。

sentences.en: But yeah, anger is still a part of my life, much less so than it was before.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，愤怒仍然是我生活的一部分，尽管比以前少了很多。

sentences.en: My children don't seem to come across angry in any way.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们似乎没有表现出任何愤怒的情绪。

sentences.en: And I'm very grateful for that.
sentences.zh: 对此我非常感激。

sentences.en: So I try to keep my anger away from them as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 所以我尽量不让愤怒影响到他们。

sentences.en: I'll let them see it occasionally because I think it's right that they do.
sentences.zh: 我偶尔会让他们看到我的愤怒，因为我觉得让他们看到是正确的。

sentences.en: And I don't want to kind of hide things and lie about things.
sentences.zh: 我不想遮遮掩掩或说谎。

sentences.en: But there's certain elements of my anger that they don't need to see.
sentences.zh: 但我的愤怒中有些特定成分是他们没必要看到的。

sentences.en: And there's, yeah, there's a funny moment where I'd written a lot about my anger.
sentences.zh: 而且，有一个有趣的时刻，我写了很多关于自己愤怒的事。

sentences.en: There's a lot in my book about my anger and how that's changed over time.
sentences.zh: 我的书里有很多关于我的愤怒以及它随时间如何改变的内容。

sentences.en: But I wrote about how when I first saw this blackbird and I could see how it was free and it was kind of liberated from any kind of restrictions in life.
sentences.zh: 但我写到，当我第一次看到这只黑鸟时，我能看出它是多么自由，它从生活中任何形式的束缚中解放出来了。

sentences.en: And that's maybe how I saw Steve now.
sentences.zh: 这也许就是我现在看待史蒂夫的方式。

sentences.en: And I think there was a moment where the house was a mess and I was knackered and I was fed up and the girls were having a bad day.
sentences.zh: 我想当时有这样一个时刻，家里一团糟，我精疲力竭，烦透了，女孩们那天过得很糟糕。

sentences.en: And I saw the blackbird turn up and I had some really dark thoughts about what I wanted to do to this blackbird.
sentences.zh: 我看到那只黑鸟出现，脑子里闪过一些非常黑暗的念头，想着我对这只黑鸟做点什么。

sentences.en: And I wrote that in my book.
sentences.zh: 我把这写进了我的书里。

sentences.en: And when it was being edited by my proofreader, he said, whoa, you can't say that.
sentences.zh: 当我的校对员在审稿时，他说：“哇，你不能这么写。”

sentences.en: So he helped me filter that down to more appropriate language around how I felt about the blackbird.
sentences.zh: 于是他帮我把文字润色了一下，换成了更合适的语言来表达我对这只黑鸟的感受。

sentences.en: But yeah, it has softened over time.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，这种情绪确实缓和了。

sentences.en: I've learned more about how I need to understand the place Steve was in.
sentences.zh: 我更多地去理解史蒂夫当时所处的境地。

sentences.en: I've learned more about suicide and how it changes the way people feel and how mental health can impact people in such different ways, which I didn't know anything about before.
sentences.zh: 我对自杀有了更多的了解，知道了它是如何改变人们的感受的，以及心理健康会以如此截然不同的方式影响人们，这些是我以前一无所知的。

sentences.en: So yeah, anger has been massive.
sentences.zh: 所以，愤怒的影响确实太巨大了。

sentences.en: And I actually shared the manuscript with somebody just like me who'd lost a husband to suicide when she had two young children, not that long ago.
sentences.zh: 不久前，我实际上把手稿分享给了一位和我有类似经历的人，她曾经有两个年幼的孩子，却因自杀失去了丈夫。

sentences.en: And she read my manuscript and gave me some amazing feedback on it recently.
sentences.zh: 她读了我的手稿，最近给了我一些非常棒的反馈。

sentences.en: And the biggest point, other than things like, she said, I can share it with my mum and she can now understand where I'm coming from.
sentences.zh: 最重要的一点是，除了像她说的那样“我可以把它分享给我妈妈，她现在能理解我的想法了”之外，

sentences.en: But the biggest point was that she was nodding all the way through it when I talked about the anger.
sentences.zh: 最重要的一点是，当我谈到愤怒时，她一路都在点头赞同。

sentences.en: And she'd never felt that she could show that anger or talk about it because there's so much sympathy for the person that's died and what a sad place they must have been in
sentences.zh: 她以前从觉得不自己能够表现出那种愤怒或谈论它，因为大家对逝者以及他们为了走到那一步

sentences.en: to get to that point.
sentences.zh: 而陷入的悲惨境地充满了同情

sentences.en: That it feels inappropriate almost to talk about how you're angry with them.
sentences.zh: 以至于讨论你对他们的愤怒几乎显得很不合时宜。

sentences.en: And we don't want to blame them and we don't want to bring about shame.
sentences.zh: 我们不想责怪他们，我们也不想带来耻辱。

sentences.en: But anger still exists because of the circumstances that we find ourselves in.
sentences.zh: 但由于我们所处的境况，愤怒依然存在。

sentences.en: It really does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And, you know, we think about anger as being a secondary emotion.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们认为愤怒是一种次要情绪。

sentences.en: So something else always comes firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以总是有别的东西先出现。

sentences.en: And the fact that you're not seeing that in your girls at the moment, I think, again, reinforces what a great job you're doing at helping them recognise
sentences.zh: 而你现在在你的女孩们身上没有看到这种情绪，我认为这再次印证了你在帮助她们识别

sentences.en: and discuss their primary emotions.
sentences.zh: 和讨论她们的核心情绪方面做得多么出色。

sentences.en: So maybe they are feeling abandoned.
sentences.zh: 所以也许她们确实感到被抛弃了。

sentences.en: Maybe they are feeling disappointed.
sentences.zh: 也许她们确实感到失望。

sentences.en: Maybe they are feeling sad.
sentences.zh: 也许她们确实感到难过。

sentences.en: Maybe they're feeling jealous of their peers who still have both parents.
sentences.zh: 也许她们会对那些父母双全的同龄人感到嫉妒。

sentences.en: And when we're able to properly tap into those primary emotions, there's less need for the secondary emotions.
sentences.zh: 当我们能够真正触及那些核心情绪时，对次要情绪的需求就会减少。

sentences.en: And again, just shows me what a great job you're doing.
sentences.zh: 这再次向我展示了你做得有多棒。

sentences.en: I think that's really helpful, though, what you've said there.
sentences.zh: 不过，你刚才说的话真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: And I think the different emotions that you've listed are really, I mean, there's endless emotions that we can talk about.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为你列举出的不同情绪，我的意思是，我们可以谈论的情绪有无数种。

sentences.en: But it's good to have a broader vocabulary of emotions that you can help children to use.
sentences.zh: 但能够拥有更广泛的情绪词汇来帮助孩子们表达是一件好事。

sentences.en: Because for me, it's been sad and angry a lot of the time.
sentences.zh: 因为对我和来说，很多时候都是伤心和愤怒。

sentences.en: And I need to remind myself that there's a lot on that scale in between.
sentences.zh: 我需要提醒自己，在这两者之间还有很大的尺度。

sentences.en: And they need to know that, too.
sentences.zh: 她们也需要了解这一点。

sentences.en: And like you say, that kind of maybe resentment towards friends who've got the most amazing dad and they don't have that.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，那种对拥有绝世好爸爸而自己却没有的朋友的怨恨情绪。

sentences.en: And moments in the future when Steve isn't there to walk them down the aisle when they're getting married.
sentences.zh: 以及在未来，当她们结婚时，史蒂夫无法陪伴她们走过红毯的时刻。

sentences.en: And those are moments where anger might appear or any of those other emotions.
sentences.zh: 在这些时刻，愤怒或任何其他情绪都可能会出现。

sentences.en: And we're not out of the woods now and we never will be.
sentences.zh: 我们现在还没有脱离险境，而且永远都不会。

sentences.en: But by equipping ourselves with coping mechanisms to deal with all of these different emotions,
sentences.zh: 但通过为自己配备应对所有这些不同情绪的应对机制，

sentences.en: I'm hopeful that we've got a decent future ahead of us.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们能有一个不错的未来。

sentences.en: I really, I feel so certain of that.
sentences.zh: 真的，我对此深信不疑。

sentences.en: It's been an absolute pleasure speaking with you.
sentences.zh: 与你交谈绝对是一件愉快的事。

sentences.en: So keep doing what you're doing, both for the community, but for yourself and your girls.
sentences.zh: 所以请继续坚持你正在做的事，为了社区，也为了你自己和你的女孩们。

sentences.en: I can't wait to read Daddy Blackbird when it's available.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待地想在《黑鸟爸爸》出版后拜读它。

sentences.en: And I will share that freely on my networks as well once it's published.
sentences.zh: 一旦出版，我也会在我的社交网络上自由分享它。

sentences.en: But thank you so much for your time, Caroline.
sentences.zh: 卡洛琳，非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: I really appreciate the opportunity to talk about all of this and your lovely approach to listening and understanding.
sentences.zh: 我非常感激能有这个机会谈论这一切，也感谢你充满爱心的倾听和理解方式。

sentences.en: Well, you're so welcome.
sentences.zh: 不用客气。

sentences.en: It's been an absolute pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一次愉快的交流。

sentences.en: And it's such an important conversation to have.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常重要的对话主题。

sentences.en: And I'm hopeful that this episode will trickle through where it needs to.
sentences.zh: 我希望这一集能够传递到需要它的人那里。

sentences.en: It will be listened to and watched by health professionals, but also by people who are interested in learning about this stuff and might be experiencing, you know,
sentences.zh: 它将被医疗专业人员收听和观看，也会被那些有兴趣了解这些事情、并且可能正在经历

sentences.en: some of the stuff that you've been through too.
sentences.zh: 你所经历过的一些事情的人所关注。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm hopeful that it can help somebody.
sentences.zh: 我希望它能帮助到某个人。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Just before we finish, could you tell us where people can connect with you on socials, Caroline?
sentences.zh: 在结束之前，卡洛琳，能告诉大家在哪里可以通过社交媒体与你联系吗？

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 可以，没问题。

sentences.en: I talk frequently on LinkedIn, so I can be found there.
sentences.zh: 我经常在领英上发声，所以可以在那里找到我。

sentences.en: I don't think there's many other Caroline Roodhouses around.
sentences.zh: 我想叫卡洛琳·鲁德豪斯的人并不多。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I'd love to connect with people on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我很乐意在领英上与大家交流。

sentences.en: And my website, again, is www.daddyblackbird.com where you can connect with me there too.
sentences.zh: 我的网站是 www.daddyblackbird.com，你也可以在那里与我联系。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Oh, what an incredibly powerful episode.
sentences.zh: 哦，多么令人震撼的一集啊。

sentences.en: What a real privilege it was to speak to Caroline.
sentences.zh: 能与卡洛琳交谈真是一种荣幸。

sentences.zh: 如果我们在今天进行的对话以及即将出版的书籍能够引起你的共鸣，请务必去领英上关注她。

sentences.zh: 请务必在YouTube上订阅并在Spotify上关注本节目。

sentences.zh: 同时，当思考悲伤时，请记住我的其中一本书，

sentences.zh: 《悲伤集体》（The Grief Collective），它在亚马逊上获得了极好的反馈。

sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分，我们很快再见。
